name: Angel
summary: Angel Robotics Co Ltd is a company at the forefront of designing, manufacturing, and distributing sophisticated intelligent wearable robots. Their primary product offerings include angel MEDI, a wearable robot tailored for rehabilitation medicine; angel GEAR, an industrial-grade wearable robot; angel SUIT, crafted to assist with daily living activities; and angel KIT, which provides essential robotic parts such as motor drivers and smart actuators. Furthermore, the company offers specialized research and development services for wearable robot solutions intended for defense purposes.
